messages:
Marta: Morning — noticed two distinct mug stacks, one labeled 'Desk mugs' and one random pile. Also spice cabinet is missing cumin. Anyone raid it last night? :thinking_face:
Kevin: guilty? not guilty. I borrowed cumin for lunch prep, left the jar half empty. I'll replace by EOD. :raised_hands:
Arnav: can we add a 'claim' sticker to mugs? People keep taking mugs from desks. I can print labels if we have the label printer creds.
Marta: @Arnav yes please. Label printer is on the shelf by the router, code on the sticky note. Also filter change for the drip machine is due Friday — any volunteers?
Sofia: I'll do filter change Friday morning before standup. Reminder: set timer in calendar.
Kevin: I'll order replacement cumin + a tiny spice kit (thyme, oregano). Any brand prefs?
Marta: no strong prefs. Torey likes single-origin. :sweat_smile:
kitchen-bot: Reminder: Office pantry stock low: Oat milk (1 carton), Black tea (2 boxes), Sugar (low). To request restock, use /kitchen-order <item> or visit https://orders.example.com/pantry
Arnav: can we also add a small 'mug tag' sheet on the fridge: put your name + emoji. Casual system.
Sofia: poll — dumplings for Friday lunch? Yes/No/Bring your own?
Marta: vote: Yes
Kevin: vote: Yes, pork
Arnav: vote: Vegetarian option pls
Sofia: Poll results so far: 3 yes (1 veg request). I'll place order for 12 with 4 veg. ETA 12:15 Friday.
Marta: thanks! Kevin replace cumin and leave receipt in the coffee fund box. :receipt:
Kevin: will do. Also FYI I left a tiny label maker tape inside the router box.
Marta: tagged the 'Desk mugs' with blue washi tape. Let's see if it helps. :crossed_fingers:
Sofia: thank you team!
